goal.title: Build a WORKING Albion bot — autonomous gameplay (navigate, gather, combat, bank, market, quests), driven via the most-tractable surface per capability (clientless protocol where it works; the REAL game client where it does not).
goal.metric: workstreams_done / total_workstreams (PARALLEL, not a serial spine)
goal.done_when: the bot autonomously runs a full gameplay loop (travel -> gather/kill -> return -> bank/sell) with no human input
goal.scope_note: LOGIN/credential is ONE workstream, NOT the goal. Do not collapse the whole goal to a serial S1 spine. Clientless S2/S3/S4 codec is offline-green; clientless S1 from-scratch login is EAC/EOS-gated = a TRUE external gate for the CLIENTLESS surface ONLY. The bot's BEHAVIORS (pathing, combat, gather, bank, market, quest, multi-account) are INDEPENDENT workstreams buildable NOW against gamestate-store + captured pcaps + the live tutorial-capable GPU client. The CREDENTIAL is obtained by RUNNING the proven albion_e2e.py pipeline on the real client (see facts[0]), NOT by forging the clientless login. DECOMPOSE into >=3 PARALLEL workstreams; run one per pool box.
goal.surfaces: clientless-protocol (S2/S3/S4 green, S1 gated) | real-game-client-on-GPU-box (albion_e2e.py proven account->in-world) — pick per workstream
